experiment: three mode-20 constructor mechanisms, implemented in parallel isolated worktrees (workflow wf_4e65b4b5-a24, sonnet agents), band-measured on salts 320.000-320.007 against the HEAD control and endpoint-screened after full pv26 descent with the HEAD binary

gap-stations.verdict: REJECTED - band worse on every salt AND endpoints worse 1-3

mating-orientation-prior.verdict: NEUTRAL, not adopted - band slightly worse, endpoints mixed 2-2 within noise. Its best endpoint (186.936, salt 320.004) fed two alternation chains that both landed on the 179.006 structural plateau as independent layouts (see plateau-179.006/), so the variant contributed basin diversity even though the mechanism itself was not adopted.

pocket-refill.outputIdentity: final placements verified 61/61 identical to the HEAD control construction on ALL 8 salts (including 320.003 with 15 confirms and 6 passthroughs) - refill-bearing beam children never survive final beam selection
pocket-refill.endpointScreen: unnecessary - constructions identical to control, descents would be identical
pocket-refill.verdict: NOT ADOPTED as-is - mechanism is real (fires on 4/8 salts, up to 19 confirmed coordinated two-piece insertions) but the children carrying fillers always rank below filler-free children at final selection. Mechanism finding: trapped-void components in this concave-heavy fixture are rarely rectangular (median fill_ratio 0.47, max ~0.70), so a rigid bbox-anchored filler is a poor fit; when a refill does confirm, the resulting sealed layout scores worse than leaving the void open for later pieces.

protocolNote: bands measured by each agent with its own worktree binary (isolated CARGO_TARGET_DIR); endpoint screens ran the variant constructions through the unmodified HEAD pv26 descent driver so descent machinery is matched; gap-stations constructions were regenerated deterministically with the agent binary because raw outputs were not retained
